[[Category:Baked recipes]]
[[Category:Main course recipes]]

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) skinless wild [[Cookbook:Salmon|salmon]] fillets, pin bones removed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] panko [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]], place panko in another pan, and place lemon juice in a large bowl.
#Using wet-hand dry-hand, [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] salmon into flour then into lemon, then into panko. Coat with olive oil and place on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the center of a 375°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 27 minutes or until slightly underdone.
#Remove from oven, and heat up the [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]]. Place salmon under broiler and cook until deeply browned.
#Serve immediately.
